name: agent-chronicle
description: Turns your AI coding-agent sessions into the story of how a project was built. chronicle joins the agentsview session index with git to produce a presentable storyboard, a leadership brief, and an evidence-linked audit of intent, plans, backtracks, and what shipped; dev-coach scores how you direct your agents and shows better prompts.

interface.shortDescription: The story of how your agents built a project, and how to direct them better
interface.longDescription: Joins every agent session indexed by agentsview with git history to reconstruct a project's original intent, chapters, backtracks, and what shipped, as a storyboard, a leadership brief, and an evidence-linked audit. A coach scores how you framed, planned, verified, and steered the work, quoting your own prompts.
defaultPrompt: Tell the story of how this project was built
Audit the agent sessions behind this repo
Coach me on how I direct coding agents in this project
